description: Pylon is a B2B support platform with an API and webhooks for reading and acting on its data.
auth_notes: Admin users generate an API token to authenticate requests; sources do not state how the token is sent on calls.
gate_detail: Only Admin users can create API tokens. Sources do not say which pricing tier or plan includes API access, nor whether a free plan or sandbox exists.
api_scope: API reference covers accounts, contacts, issues, messages, custom fields, custom objects, tasks and projects, knowledge base, macros, tags, teams, surveys and users; SDKs exist for TypeScript, Python, Go.
mcp_notes: Pricing page lists a Pylon MCP server as a platform feature; no URL given in sources.
blocker_detail: Token creation requires an Admin user; plan requirements for API access are not stated in the sources.

evidence.quote: Only Admin users can create API tokens.
As an Admin, generate an API token in Pylon to authenticate your requests.
To call the API from TypeScript, Python, or Go, use our SDKs
Go to the Webhooks page in Settings and specify your target endpoint URL, along with any custom headers.

uncertainties: How the API token is sent on requests is not stated for Pylon; the Bearer-token article (S1) concerns a different product (Luminous) and was not used.
Which plan tier includes API access is not stated; no free tier or trial described.
S6 (getpylon.com) is a different product (solar software) and was ignored.
